name: Joke Expiry Rush
hook: Post every last 'we got this before GTA 6' meme before the clock runs out
tagline: A sleep-deprived creator frantically scribbles absurd 'before GTA 6' captions on a smoking whiteboard as the countdown digits flicker red. Cashing out locks in a viral post archive and rolls the credits early. Crashing triggers the midnight launch bell, instantly deprecating every punchline into stale internet museum dust.
